parts:
Howdy R community!

I am working up a facet grid with a 3x2 (rows*column) of bar graphs  each containing three response variables. I computed means from string data and organized it in vectors using "ddply". At that point I have vector data that I am having issues plotting means by stage. The "which" function has been really useful for calling specific variables out of the "stage" vector. I would like to code the ggplot output to take specific "stage" and "trap" variables  from summary data an articulate a 3x2 facet. Right now I have it coded to make on single ggplot object and that is being a pain to figure out how to build into one plot. 

Anyone in the community have a moment to help out?

Below is the script from my console:

How would you add to it?

##Assigned values for csv files##

> s8 <- sept_8_trap_post.hoc
> head(s8)

### now in ggplot I begin to build the graph with summary data as listed above per life stage
###  i do this per life stage assigning each as its own identity object. 

mt8 <- ggplot(trp8[which(trp8$Stage == 'Male'),], aes(x=Trap, y=mean, fill = Stage))+
  geom_bar(position=position_dodge(0.8), stat="identity",
           color="black",
           size=0.3,
           width = 0.65, 
           show.legend = NA, binwidth = 0.6)+
  facet_grid( ~ Stage, scales="free_x") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-sd, ymax=mean+sd),
                size=.3,    # Thinner lines
                width=.2,
                position=position_dodge(.9)) +
  xlab("Trap Shape") +
  ylab("Mean Captures (+/- SD)") +
  ggtitle("Male") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=0:100*10)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position='none')

print(mt8)
